fast_rag.description: Fast RAG: hybrid search, rerank, grounded answer with citations

playground.description: Playground: one question against a draft or live pipeline, with every step

assistant.description: Assistant: Auto routes each question to Fast or the Agent; the Agent calls tools and waits for approval before writes

automation.description: Automation: one run of an automation's steps as its service identity, waiting for approvals

automation_draft.description: Automation draft: a description becomes a draft trigger and steps (no side effects)

answer_once.description: Answer once: one question with the live pipeline, nothing stored as a chat (refreshing saved answers)
